title: carex litorosa
intro: Carex litorosa, commonly known as seaside sedge, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been used for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. Additionally, Carex litorosa has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory infections, making it a valuable medicinal plant in traditional medicine.
